title: Calipso: a multi-brand design system, from Figma to code
description: kubo.financiero's design system. I unified it in 2023 and in 2026 took it to code with AI: multi-brand, for web and React Native, with quality rules that check themselves.
reto: In 2023 there were several libraries and several ways of doing the same thing: visual inconsistency, duplicated work and friction with development. I unified them into a single system in Figma, documented in Storybook. Three years later the challenge was different: the system had to serve more than one brand, live in code with the same rules as in Figma, and be solid enough to build a complete product on top of it without inventing anything.

proceso.investigacion: In 2023 I interviewed devs and PMs and reviewed the flows to find the base components. In 2026 I audited the system against real use: I checked text contrast across all 351 Storybook stories, in every brand and theme, and documented every decision with its rationale.
proceso.diseno: Figma is the source of truth. Every change is tried first on a test page, moves into the system with its documentation, and is logged with a script that replicates it. I organised the tokens in layers (base values, brand aliases and light/inverse theme aliases) so a component can switch brands without touching its code.
proceso.desarrollo: I took the system to code with Claude Code: 55 React and TypeScript components, tokens generated from Figma into CSS and into a React Native theme, and Storybook documentation with concept, web and native for each foundation. AI speeds up the building; the rules, the review in Figma and every decision are mine.
proceso.analisisDatos: Quality checks itself. On every change, CI verifies contrast pairs, that no component uses hard-coded colours, that tokens exist, and that the docs don't mention tokens that no longer exist. If anything fails, it doesn't get in.

resultados: One library instead of many, with clear rules for development (2023)
Multi-brand: 2 brands, each in light and inverse themes, from the same tokens
55 React components and a React Native theme generated from the same sources
200+ changes since April 2026, each one checked by CI: contrast, tokens and colours
Proven on a real product: a complete 8-stage SPEI transfer flow, built in 9 days using only system components
aprendizajes: A system is only a source of truth if nobody can bypass it, which is why the rules live in CI and not in a document. Layered tokens turned adding a brand into changing aliases, not components. And AI changed what it costs to build: testing an idea in code now takes days, so design work shifts towards defining the rules well and reviewing with judgement. The next step is packaging it as a library so other teams can install it.
